issues.description: The problem statement (UML and tasks) specifies getTotalNumberOfStudents() as a public method, but the solution implementation declares this method with protected visibility. This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended accessibility and may prevent code (or tests) that expect a public method from compiling or working correctly.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility of getTotalNumberOfStudents() consistent with the specification (public). Change the method declaration in the solution (and ensure the template signature/instructions indicate the same) to: public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() { ... } so students and tests see the intended public API.
